[0;32mUsage: [0m[0;33mhm stop [-t seconds] [--snapshot] [service...]
[0m[0;32mExample: [0m[0;33mhm stop phpfpm
[0m[0;32mDescription:[0m Stop docker services
[0;32mOptions:
[0m   [0;33m[-t|--timeout]  [0m Seconds each container is given to stop before it is killed
   [0;33m[-|--snapshot]  [0m Save a database snapshot before stopping
[0;32mArguments:
[0m   [0;33m<service-name>  [0mStop specific container of the service-name.
